name: whisper-large-v3-turkish-medical
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-10.

benchmarks.name: Real-voice medical WER % (120 clips, 3 speakers)
benchmarks.config: Card '## Sonuclar' table '| Degerlendirme | Metrik | M0 | M1 | M2 |': row 'Gercek-ses medikal, 3 konusmacı / 120 klip', WER: M0 openai/whisper-large-v3 0.1060, M1 general-Turkish sibling 0.1176, M2 (this repo) 0.0854. CER on the same row 0.0258 -> 0.0190. LoRA (r=64, q_proj/v_proj) merged into full weights, no adapter shipped. CAVEAT: 'best-performing speaker' rows (0.0588 vs 0.0956) are cherry-picked, and the 0.55% synthetic in-domain WER is a stated upper bound on validation data.

benchmarks.name: General Turkish WER % (320 real clips)
benchmarks.config: Same table, row 'Genel Turkce, 320 gercek klip', WER: M0 base 0.1213 vs M2 this repo 0.0795. The general-only sibling M1 is marginally better here (0.0792), so the medical-data increment is a wash on general speech.
